mechanism.tracker: scripts/orchestration/lane_status.py (read-only; state derived from workflow journals, runner outputs, validation/ files, and the fired-trigger ledger; idempotent)

daemon.event_log: <scratchpad>/orchestration/events.log (append-only: DAEMON_START/EXIT, STATE transitions into terminal states, TRIGGER_READY once per trigger)

wake.tool: harness Monitor tailing events.log (filter: TRIGGER_READY, DAEMON_START/EXIT, TRACKER_ERROR, done_open_issues, structural_fail, verified_provisional, error)
wake.expiry: 30 min (harness cap); re-armed at each expiry, when the daemon heartbeat is also checked

mechanism.actions: taken by the operator (this session) on a TRIGGER_READY event; each firing appended to docs/orchestration/fired_triggers.jsonl and committed

workflows.wf_02471fb6-48c: preliminary v1 forensics (completed; superseded by lanes 02, 03, 29)

survival.daemon + runners: survive tool-task deaths and session idle (detached); do NOT survive container reclamation
survival.monitor: harness task; expires every 30 min and is re-armed; lost if the session ends
survival.workflows: run inside this session; resumable only in the same session (resumeFromRunId); lost on container reclamation

restart_semantics: On any wake or resume: check the daemon heartbeat (< 3 min old) and PID; if dead, relaunch the daemon (state is re-derived; TRIGGER_READY is re-emitted only for triggers absent from events.log, and the ledger prevents double firing). If runners died, the pinned manifests' structural check shows missing keys; rerun only missing shards' keys is NOT allowed mid-dataset without an owner decision — report instead.
